primary_population: initial prediction-preserving source pathways grouped by model-predicted class
heldout_population: all validation activations grouped by model-predicted class
threshold_fit: training source pathways only; positive=min selected activation, negative=max selected activation
predicate_identity: model + predicted class + signed physical feature + class-specific threshold
representative_class_rule: nearest class to the 10th, 50th, and 90th percentile of 1 - n80/observed-selected-predicates
cross_model_pairing: none; saved activation files lack explicit shared source-image IDs
